issues.problem: Context 1 (電車で大声で騒ぐなんて、{}だ) let 言語道断 from the same set fill the braces just as well.
issues.action: Rewrote it as narration with 周りの目も気にせず{傍若無人}に騒いでいた, a slot (adverbial に + 騒ぐ) that 言語道断 cannot take.

issues.problem: Context 3 reply 本当に{}だね after a queue-jumper was also open to 言語道断.
issues.action: Added 周りの人が見えてないのかな before the idiom so that the 'as if no one else were there' sense is what the situation calls for; English updated.

issues.problem: Story said Japanese 'now writes it' with 恐; the original spelling 戦々兢々 is still in use, so the claim was too absolute.
issues.action: Changed to 'now usually writes it'. Source (詩経 小雅・小旻) and the rest of the story checked and kept.

issues.idiom: 玉石混交 / 傍若無人 / 千載一遇 / 温故知新
issues.problem: Stories checked: 抱朴子 外篇・尚博 (真偽顛倒、玉石混淆), 史記 刺客列伝 (Jing Ke and Gao Jianli, 旁若無人者), 袁宏「三国名臣序賛」in 文選 (千載一遇、賢智之嘉会), 論語 為政 (温故而知新、可以為師矣).

issues.idiom: 天真爛漫 / 電光石火
issues.problem: Stories are null. Both have origins that are sometimes cited (a Yuan-dynasty source for 天真爛漫, Zen texts for 電光石火), but I am not certain enough of the exact source and wording.
